jobs_results.title: Senior Engineer, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

You, as a driven agile team member, will be working closely with the development teams to implement and support their continuous integration, in order to ensure stable and reliable releases of our platform. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our container-based microservice infrastructure, to improve the availability and resilience of our services. With your motivation and knowledge in the latest cloud technologies, like Terraform and Kubernetes, you can create a scalable and solid architecture.

About the Team

The Platform area is responsible for developing and maintaining our internal APIs, services, infrastructure and security. The teams in the area support other Product teams by providing tools & services to enable the smoothest delivery possible of our Products. With a strong sense of ownership, you will ensure the timely and efficient delivery of high-quality code, a high level of performance and design whilst also developing innovative... compelling and cutting-edge systems that support our operations.

What you’ll do
• Development of our tools and improving systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance our system and develop new features
• Enhancement of our terraform codebase and infrastructure pipeline to support rapid feature delivery
• Monitoring and upgrading our systems and server setups to guarantee stability and security
• Mentor junior team members

Who you are
• Possess strong expertise in Cloud and AWS-based infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, etc.).
• Have a minimum of 3 years of experience with Docker, Kubernetes/ECS, and Terraform.
• Demonstrate proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, Travis CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar.
• Showcase experience in building and maintaining real-time application monitoring and deep knowledge of troubleshooting hotspots.
• Exhibit familiarity with languages like Bash, Python and Golang. Kafka knowledge is preferred

jobs_results.title: IT Operations Engineer (DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
Our Operations Team runs customer-facing systems as well as our internal IT infrastructure. As a DevOps Engineer you will be responsible for the setup, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting of our Linux-based infrastructure.

About the job:
• We run software like nginx, PHP 8, MariaDB, Solr, Redis and RabbitMQ
• We work according to the principle “Infrastructure as Code” with Continuous Integration Patterns using Jenkins and Ansible
• We design and implement monitoring and alerting solutions (Grafana, InfluxDB, New Relic, etc.)
• As part of our DevOps team, you will be responsible for the administration and design of Linux-based cloud, container, and dedicated systems (Debian, Alpine)
• You will work closely together with the Engineering teams on performance, scalability and operability

What you bring along:
• Secure handling of configuration management tools (ideally Ansible)
• Experience with Docker Containers and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins)
• Good knowledge of a scripting... language (e.g. Bash, Python, Groovy etc.)
• Debugging and troubleshooting skills in a distributed environment
• Experience in running a large-scale relational database system (MySQL, MariaDB) is a plus

Are you the right one for the job?
Then send us your application (CV and cover letter) today!

If you want to know more about your future team and what working at InterNations is like, just have a look at this interview with one of our DevOps Engineers on our corporate blog

jobs_results.title: Senior Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer, Platform & Reliability...
jobs_results.description:
The Platform team is responsible for developing and maintaining the infrastructure and systems that enable a company's products and services.

The goal of the Platform team is to provide software as the products, tools, services, and frameworks to enable Product teams to focus on customer needs instead of tooling. We work closely with the Product teams to increase their productivity and speed up software delivery.

Overall, a platform engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring a company's technology infrastructure is reliable and scalable.

The Platform team consists of 37 people including 6 Team Leaders and 4 Engineering Managers. The team is organized in a way to efficiently addresses Stakeholders needs.

What are the challenges in the team?

• The complexity of the Docplanner organization: Docplanner is a complex organization with multiple teams working on various products and services. One of the main challenges for the platform engineering team is to understand and... integrate the diverse technology stacks used by different teams.
• Scalability and reliability of systems: As Docplanner grows and expands, the demand for the technology infrastructure also increases. The platform engineering team must ensure that the systems are designed to handle high traffic, are scalable, and secure

Who will you work closely with?

You will work closely with Product Teams to understand their technical requirements and provide them with the necessary tools, services, and infrastructure to support their development efforts. Your insights and expertise will contribute to enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of their workflows.

How would you be impacting our mission?

• Development, monitoring, and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters on several continents.
• CI / CD development and maintenance.
• Make sure that all of our services are written in a way that makes them highly available.
• Fixing urgent issues and optimizing performance.
• Support other team members in their daily work.

What will help you thrive?

• Vast experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes (must-have).
• You know why and how to use Terraform and popular CI/CD tools.
• You know about building scalable and secure production HA environments using AWS.
• You are not afraid of developing tools or scripts in Bash or GO to automate work.
• You can communicate in English (both spoken and written - min. B2 level).
• Growth mindset: nobody ticks all those boxes above, but willingness to learn is strongly valued here.

Let’s talk money

• A salary adequate to your experience and skills between 60,000 and 85,000 euros. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;
• Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings;
• Share options plan after 6 months of working with us.

True flexibility and work-life balance

• Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona;
• Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);
• Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier);
• 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays;
• Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

• Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental);
• Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Andjoy;
• Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

• 20% time rule: spend 20% of your working hours on personal development related to your role and collaboration with other teams;;
• Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

jobs_results.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Admin
jobs_results.description:
Description

About Apex ESG Advantage

Our current economic system has brought unprecedented levels of welfare and prosperity. Yet, in many ways, this has come at a great environmental and societal cost. The time has come to forge a new path, and to transition to a more sustainable economy.

Apex ESG Advantage is one of the fastest growing ESG and sustainability firms in Europe, experiencing solid growth over the past 24 months. Our team consists of approximately 150 people from various backgrounds across Amsterdam, London, New York, Valencia and Mumbai all driven by the ambition to make a real impact.

Launched in 2021, Apex ESG Advantage is a business-to-business (b2b) software as a Service (SaaS) platform that allows companies to track their ESG performance and benchmark it against their peers and industry best practices. Specifically designed for the private equity market, it provides investors and fund managers with a holistic overview of the performance of their portfolio... companies.

The role

As a DevOps and Infrastructure Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud-based infrastructure, while ensuring seamless CI/CD pipelines and robust security practices. Our system is constantly evolving with new technologies and the job may require learning new skills and industry practices as new computing resources are adopted.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with developers, operations teams, and security experts to identify and implement best practices for secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
• Implement security best practices across systems, networks, and applications to safeguard sensitive data and maintain compliance.
• Maintain documentation related to infrastructure architecture, deployment processes, and standard operating procedures.
• Proactively monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure issues, ensuring minimal downtime and quick resolution of problems.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, sharing insights and knowledge within the team.

Skills & Experience

• 2+ years in a DevOps or Infrastructure role, showcasing hands-on experience with designing and managing complex IT systems.
• Proficiency in cloud platforms (e.g. Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g. Kubernetes).
• Expertise in Git and MS DevOps, specifically in designing and managing efficient CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with security protocols, compliance standards, and security assessment frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and collaborative approach.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Total Benefits

Our belief in promoting a healthy work-life balance drives us to support our employees total well-being, offering comprehensive benefits not limited to:

• We offer competitive pay and benefits to employees.
• Health Insurance.
• Working Schedule: Fridays reduced hours as well as August.

More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please visithttps://theapexgroup.com/csr-policy/

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our fabulous recruiting team will then review your application and follow up with you if you seem like a great fit for this role

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Dev Ops Engineer to start immediately. This would be a full-time on-site position at our office in Barcelona. The same position in Madrid office is also available.

The job requires the following responsabilities:
• Leading test and integration efforts with regards to deploying mission critical software.
• Developing new ways of automation and continuous delivery.
• Taking ownership of technical issues, and working with our Development group to resolve more advanced issues when necessary.
• Resolving escalated customer complaints.
• Documenting troubleshooting and problem resolution steps.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or related field.
• Have exceptional troubleshooting and customer-handling skills.
• Show excellent communication in English (both verbal and written).
• Proven experience working with distributed Linux operating systems (installation, configuration and troubleshooting).
• Understanding of... Linux core fundamentals, command-line operations, scripting and service monitoring.
• Solid understanding of IP networking and network devices.
• Experience with Kernel and network based tuning for performance and stability.
• Experience with automation and configuration management using provisioning tools like Ansible.
• Strong support and/or administration experience for enterprise software solutions.
• Good scripting skills (awk, sed, bash).
• Understanding of one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, or C++.
• Firm understanding of version control systems such as subversion.
• Solid understanding of agilie methodologies, working in small teams, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a Senior DevOps engineer, you will focus your technical expertise on evaluating and streamlining existing processes, identifying bottlenecks and working around them to improve overall operational efficiency.

Responsibilties:
• Identifying bottlenecks in current practices and addressing these by designing automation around Kubernetes infrastructure management, continuous integration pipelines and deployment strategies for containerised workloads, multi-tenant services and shared applications to meet time constraints.
• On other days you’ll be evaluating and driving forward, as necessary, new technologies, tools or frameworks to improve system performance and/or operational efficiency, always focusing on quality.
• Work with Solution Architects, and the rest of the DevOps teams’ members and act as a technical authority and define standards for the rest of the operational teams. On a different front, mentor and collaborate, setting clear and tangible requirements for the success of... the organisation.
• Holds SRE practices at heart and strongly believes good observability practices lead to an intimate understanding of platform behaviour and performance, with which one may also proactively detect problems in not-so-familiar systems.
• The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of both operational and containerisation principles, together with a proven track record of designing and delivering solutions to maintain reliable and resilient platforms.
• Previous technical experience in a senior DevOps role.
• Deep understanding of the following:
• Container platforms
• CI/CD toolchains and related practices
• Infrastructure as Code and Templating (Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize)
• Cryptography (digital certificates, key exchanges, encryption)
• Solid Linux knowledge, including filesystems, day-to-day administration cli tools, package management, patching, regex, scripting etc..
• Grasp of networking concepts, including TCP/IP layers, Load Balancers, reverse proxies, firewalling and packet inspection practices.
• Experience building, deploying, maintaining, and operating SaaS products in a cost effective manner.
• Sound understanding of the software development ecosystem: use of Git, automated testing, environment promotion, scrum methodologies etc.
• Ability to articulate technical documentation and design architecture blueprints.
• Ability to understand and capture value in emerging technologies through research.
• Concise communication and presentation skills, ability to explain complex problems effortlessly to both techies & non-technical colleagues.
• Able to work effectively in a team environment and devoted knowledge sharer.

Nice to have:
• Certifications related to the demonstrated skills that can be verified.
• Familiarity with public cloud platforms.
• Exciting opportunities for career growth
• Flexible hybrid work model
• Comprehensive international health insurance
• Health and wellbeing package worth 350 EUR per year
• Day off on your birthday
• 1 additional day off for yourself "Me Time"
• Complimentary office lunches

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect Is More Than Just a Job…
Our greatest asset is our people, and nothing is more important to us than ensuring that everyone knows that. Each of our 90+ offices has its own individual identity, and each also has its own unique rewards.

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the Artificial Intelligence team at TransPerfect and build services in Golang, NodeJS, Python, C++, and Kubernetes for millions of users.

You’d be part of a team developing our GlobalLink AI suite, that includes a web portal, APIs, and a scalable artificial intelligence platform based on microservices for which we use a state-of-the-art tech stack, including Kubernetes and Docker containers. Your goal will be to improve our CD/CI approach, automate the operations, and enable the platform to exponentially scale.

jobs_results.title: DEVOPS ENGINEER
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Apptiva Core Technologies, company specialized in SW development, experts in Digital Transformation, Blockchain, IoTs, NFTs, Cloud, every technology based in Javascript, Python and AWS environments.

Job Description

As a DevOps Engineer you will collaborate with product development teams. With a focus on automating builds via CI/CD pipelines and getting code into production as quickly and efficiently as possible.

As well as supporting services before they go live via system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews. You will use automation to scale systems sustainably and help to make improvements, evolving systems and driving change that improves the reliability, speed and security.

Work with IT Product teams to deploy newer version of software in Cloud resources. Collaborate with DevOps teams to make sure new environments meet requirements and conform to best practices.

Qualifications

MANDATORY:
•... Strong knowledge managing Jenkins.
• Strong knowledge writting Helm templates to deploy resources in OpenShift 4.X.
• Experience creating docker images (Dockerfiles and S2I).
• Experience deploying resources and managing them in Kubernetes/OpenShift.
• Experience in Git and Gitflows.
• Experience in Linux.
• ADVANCED English level

NICE TO HAVE:
• Knowledge deploying resources in AWS using Terraform.
• Knowledge architecting solutions in AWS.
• Knowledge in code analysis tools (Sonarqube and GHAS) and creating performance tests (Jmeter).
• Scripting using Python, Bash or similar.

Additional Information

Salary: 40.000 € - 60.000 €
